prompt: Light passes from air into glass of refractive index 1.5 at an angle of incidence of 30°. What is the angle of refraction?

Light of wavelength 600 nm passes through two slits 0.30 mm apart onto a screen 2.0 m away.

**(a)** Calculate the fringe separation. **[2]**

**(b)** State and explain the effect of using blue light instead. **[2]**

**(c)** State what happens at a point where the path difference is 1.5λ. **[1]**
markscheme:
**(a)** $s = \dfrac{\lambda D}{d} = \dfrac{600\times10^{-9}\times2.0}{0.30\times10^{-3}}$ ✓ $= 4.0$ mm ✓

**(b)** Fringes closer together ✓, because blue light has a shorter wavelength and $s \propto \lambda$ ✓

**(c)** Destructive interference — a dark fringe ✓
